PREFACE
BNY (BNY Mellon Technology) was scheduled to visit the campus for internship 
drive on 8th, August 2022 . The hackathon was already conducted. I’ll talk 
about the hackathon test in the furter slides.The PPT took place in VJTI itself at 
3:30 pm for almost 90 minutes.At the end of the PPT it was declared that the 
interview will be taken on the same day after the PPT at 5:00 pm.

PREP
➢
DSA: https://450dsa.com/
➢
CN:  https://www.interviewbit.com/networking- interview-questions/

s/
➢

➢

TEST
Round 1: This was an online coding round conducted on the Hackerrank platform and 
consisted of  4 questions.
➢
Easy (50 Marks): Length of the longest subarray with a sum less than or equal to k.
➢
Medium (75 Marks): I don’t remember this one, but it was easy.
➢
Hard(100 Marks): We were given a total number of nodes and edges connecting 
each node, we had to ﬁnd the sum of ceil(sqrt(no. of nodes )) in each graph.
I was able to do the easy one completely and for the other two medium questions and I 
was able to get 13/15 and 14/15 test cases for them with just brute force and didn’t try 
to optimize it.
I wasn’t able to do the 100 Marks one as I was not familiar with graphs coding.
A lot of students had applied and 18 were selected after this round, I was one of them.

TECHNICAL INTERVIEW
Round 2: Began with a general introduction and then the interviewer asked 
this questions:
➢
What data structure can be used to display all the cities in a  country 
and all the countries in a continent?
Trees
➢
One DSA question on sets was asked
➢
Is HTTP stateless or stateful protocol?
➢
What is the use of pointers in C++?
➢
What is caching?
➢
What is encapsulation?
➢
How to calculate the height and total number of leaf nodes in a tree 
using recursion?

TECHNICAL INTERVIEW
➢
There was also a question on graphs but I hadn’t practised graphs so 
he moved on to further questions.
➢
Piece of advice- Always be honest during interviews
➢
So basically OOPS, DSA and OS was asked in this round
➢
Piece of advice- For a dsa question, if you have forgotten the syntax or 
did not know the code, just share your approach with the 
interviewer.(What you were thinking about doing and how is your 
approach going to work)
Out of the 18 people, 11 people were shortlisted and the ﬁnal round was 
conducted the next day

HR INTERVIEW
➢
So this interview was taken by a person of seniority, he started with 
introduction and asked about strengths and weaknesses. 
➢
He also asked to elaborate and explain my projects, BNY main tech stack is 
web dev and i had two projects on web dev so that was deﬁnitely a plus 
point.
➢
He then asked the following questions:
  
  1.There are 20 ppl in a room , how many total handshakes will be there?
  2. How do you test your website?
In this, I told him that I haven’t come across that part in the life cycle so I don’t 
know a lot about it. Just named the various test, black box, white box etc.
   3. One DSA question was asked on hackerrank about implementing a class using 
constructors and destructors, this was a tough questions and I did not get it.

HR INTERVIEW
  4. Then he asked if there are any questions I have for him and if I 
knew what the company exactly does?
➢
Here my ﬁrst question was he has any feedback for me and then I 
asked about the company. 
➢
What would be my role in the company?
➢
One question which had an impact on him was that I asked him 
why is the tech sector of such a big bank not in it headquarters 
city itself. 
➢
He answered my questions and explained what the company does 
very passionately and after a while ended my interview.

RESULT
➢
The results came at around 8:00 pm in the evening and out of 11 
people only 5 were selected and I was one of them.As I told you 
earlier,BNY takes an extremely strict HR round from a person of 
high seniority so please be prepared accordingly.
➢
And also always research about the company before you sit for 
the interview and ask questions about the company in the HR 
round.
